profile.ja: 新世代の戦力と期待される電撃の対魔忍、水城ゆきかぜ。最強の剣士と謳われる斬鬼の対魔忍、秋山凜子。二人が組めば五車学園最強バディともいわれる。
profile.en: Mizuki Yukikaze is the electrifying Taimanin hailed as the next-generation fighting force. Akiyama Rinko is the Taimanin dubbed the strongest swordswoman, the Demon-slayer. When the two team up, they are said to be the strongest duo in Gosha Academy.

text.ja: 斬鬼の対魔忍、秋山凜子だ。ゆきかぜ共々、よろしく頼む　雷撃の対魔忍、水城ゆきかぜよ！　凜子先輩と一緒なら百人力なんだから！
text.en: I'm the Demon-slayer Taimanin, Akiyama Rinko. Together with Yukikaze, looking forward to it. I'm the lightning-strike Taimanin, Mizuki Yukikaze! With senior Rinko, we're a hundred-person force!

text.ja: 凜子せんぱーーーい！　おっと、ふふふ、ゆきかぜは今日も元気だな
text.en: Rinko-senpai! Oops, hehe, I'm feeling great today.

text.ja: ゆきかぜ、髪が乱れているぞ、梳いてやろう　あっ、ありがとう、ございます……えへへ
text.en: Yukikaze, your hair's a mess—let me comb it for you. Ah, thank you... eheh.

text.ja: 凜子先輩はね、容姿端麗なだけじゃなくて頭脳も明晰で文武両道なんだから　あ、あまり持ち上げないでくれ、私もまだまだだよ
text.en: Rinko-senpai isn't just stunningly beautiful; she's also sharp-minded and excels in both arts and arms. Ah, don't flatter me too much—I still have a long way to go.

text.ja: ゆ、ゆきかぜ、このアクセサリーは少し派手すぎないか？　凜子先輩も女の子なんですから、おしゃれしないとだめですよ！
text.en: Y-Yukikaze, isn't this accessory a little too flashy? After all, I'm a girl too, so I have to be stylish!

text.ja: 使う忍術は違うけど、そんなの関係なく凜子先輩は私のお手本なの　そう言われると身が引き締まる思いだな。私も精進しなくては
text.en: Our ninja techniques differ, but that doesn't matter—Rinko-senpai is my role model. Hearing that makes my resolve tighten. I have to keep training too.

text.ja: ゆきかぜは私の事を綺麗で羨ましいと言ってくれるが……私も時に、彼女の可愛らしさを羨ましく思ったりするんだ……内緒だぞ？
text.en: Yukikaze says I'm beautiful and enviable, but sometimes I find myself envying her cuteness too… Don't tell anyone, okay?

text.ja: 凜子先輩は憧れだけど、目標でもあるわ。いつか対魔忍として追い越してみせる。それこそが先輩への恩返しだと思うから……内緒よ？
text.en: Rinko-senpai is someone I look up to, but also my goal. One day I'll surpass her as a Taimanin—that's how I'll repay her… just between us, okay?

text.ja: んぉっ、ほ、ほおぉ、このクリチンポ鍔迫り合い、今日こそ勝ちますからぁ　おっ、んおぉ、わ、私も、逸刀流の使い手として、負けられん！
text.en: Hmm, ho, hooo, this sword clash—today I'm definitely going to win! Oh, I can't lose, not as a practitioner of Ittō-ryū!

text.ja: 凜子先輩……私、ＡＶとか初めてで　大丈夫だ。私に任せておけ……ほら、練習しておこう　あっ、こんなのどこで……あっ、あああぁ！
text.en: Rinko-senpai… it's my first time with this kind of thing, but I'll be fine. Leave it to me… let's practice. Ah, where did this come from… ah, ahhh!

text.ja: ゆきかぜ、潮を前へ飛ばすにはこうするんだ……お゛っ、おおぉおぉぉ！　凜子先輩さすがです！　ええと、こうですか？　ん゛ほおおぉぉ！
text.en: Yukikaze, to push the tide forward you do it like this… Ooo! Rinko-senpai, just as I thought! Um, is it like this? Nhoo!
